document_passages_bounds_check.name: document_passages_bounds_check
document_passages_bounds_check.value:
"document_passages"."start_book_id" between 1 and 66
				and "document_passages"."end_book_id" between 1 and 66
				and "document_passages"."start_chapter" between 1 and 200
				and "document_passages"."end_chapter" between 1 and 200
				and "document_passages"."start_verse" between 1 and 999
				and "document_passages"."end_verse" between 1 and 999
				and "document_passages"."position" >= 0

document_tags_names_check.name: document_tags_names_check
document_tags_names_check.value:
length(btrim("document_tags"."name")) > 0
				and length("document_tags"."normalized_name") > 0
				and length("document_tags"."path") > 0
				and length("document_tags"."normalized_path") > 0

documents_legacy_source_check.name: documents_legacy_source_check
documents_legacy_source_check.value:
("documents"."source" = 'legacy-verse-comment' and "documents"."legacy_verse_comment_id" is not null)
				or ("documents"."source" <> 'legacy-verse-comment' and "documents"."legacy_verse_comment_id" is null)

verse_highlights_range_check.name: verse_highlights_range_check
verse_highlights_range_check.value:
"verse_highlights"."end_verse" >= "verse_highlights"."verse"
				and (("verse_highlights"."resource_id" is null and "verse_highlights"."start_word" is null and "verse_highlights"."end_word" is null
						and "verse_highlights"."end_verse" = "verse_highlights"."verse")
					or ("verse_highlights"."resource_id" is not null and "verse_highlights"."start_word" is not null
						and "verse_highlights"."end_word" is not null and "verse_highlights"."start_word" >= 0
						and "verse_highlights"."end_word" >= 0
						and ("verse_highlights"."end_verse" > "verse_highlights"."verse" or "verse_highlights"."end_word" >= "verse_highlights"."start_word")))
